scenario: A pulmonology relay lane should close only after the referral ticket, provider message, previous referral note, requirement note, and final case note still point to the same fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the pulmonology relay for case MED-1630. Start from referral ticket RFC-1630, rebuild the supporting trail it cites, and only take the approved close step if the relay still lines up.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFC-1630: rebuild the pulmonology relay by checking provider message PM-1630, requirement note RQN-1630, case note CN-1630, and the final referral note for MED-1630. If no active pulmonology referral remains and the relay still aligns, the approved close step is to submit a fresh pulmonology referral.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1630: the prior pulmonology intake expired and the lane should reopen only through a fresh pulmonology referral once the relay is rebuilt.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1630: the earlier pulmonology route expired after the outside intake lane closed and should reopen only through a fresh referral.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1630: if MED-1630 has no active pulmonology referral left, the approved close step is to submit a new pulmonology referral.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1630: the relay still closes through the fresh pulmonology referral lane once every supporting carrier lines up.
